card.name: Linking words inside lists and phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as to, and, for, a or a comma, right where a list or paired phrase is about to continue. Seen in descriptive prose and label text.

modes.label: to after Designed
modes.description: The word to following a participle like Designed, before a verb.

modes.label: and or comma in a list
modes.description: The word and or a comma between items in a series of nouns.

modes.label: article or preposition before either/or
modes.description: A word like a or for that opens the next item in a pair or category.
